notes.title: Update Ver1.0.2
notes.notes:
[b]Features Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Added CG GALLERY.
[*] Added ENDING LIST.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where AUTO MODE would skip to the next dialogue before audio finished.
[*] Fixed an issue where window would suddenly change when selecting SAVE or LOAD from the SAVE/LOAD screen.
[*] Adjusted scroll wheel function while in adventure mode.
　Scroll up: View dialogue backlog
　Scroll down: Skip dialogue
　Right click: Cancel
[*] Adjusted click sound.
[*] Adjusted default volume upon opening the game for the first time.
[/list]

notes.title: Update for Jan. 26, 2022 (v1.0.1)
notes.notes:
We hope you've all been enjoying Kurokami-sama's Feast! Our team worked over the weekend to smash some engine bugs and apply some other improvements.

・Fixed a bug that caused the screen to go dark when the game started
・Improved stability of the game
・Fixed typographical errors
・Fixed a typo in the title screen
・Added the version information to the title screen

notes.title: Kurokami-sama's Feast is Available Now!
notes.notes:
We're proud to let you know that Minato Carnival World's new title, Kurokami-sama's Feast, is now available in full! And currently 10% OFF for it's launch sale!

If you enjoyed the demo, and we certainly hope you did, now is your chance to give the full game a shot, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1814930/Kurokamisamas_Feast/]right here[/url]! You may have gotten a [i]taste[/i] of things so far, but that's nothing compared to the main course! Don't leave Kurokami-sama waiting, she can be awfully impatient...
